body:
⭐ SaturnHolograms — Modern Hologram Plugin for Minecraft 1.21+
SaturnHolograms is a lightweight and modern hologram system designed for Minecraft 1.21+. It offers clean visuals, multi‑line support, real‑time editing, and fully customizable messages — all while staying fast and performance‑friendly.


✨ Features
✔ Multi‑line holograms ✔ Add lines without recreating the hologram ✔ Real‑time text editing ✔ Automatic saving & loading ✔ Customizable messages (messages.yml) ✔ Adjustable line spacing ✔ Clean ArmorStand‑based rendering ✔ Update notifications for new versions ✔ Works on all 1.21.x servers (Paper, Purpur, Spigot) ✔ Lightweight & optimized for any server type


Commands
/sh help – Show help menu /sh create <name> <text> – Create a hologram /sh delete <name> – Delete a hologram /sh list – List all holograms /sh addline <name> <text> – Add a new line /sh settext <name> <text> – Update hologram text

Alias: /saturnholograms | /sh


Permissions
saturnholograms.use – Access to all commands


⚙ Configuration
config.yml
• Line spacing • Storage folder • Update notifications

messages.yml
• Prefix • Help menu • Creation/deletion messages • Line editing messages

Everything is fully customizable.


Installation
Download the latest version

Drop the JAR into your /plugins/ folder

Start the server

Configure the plugin if needed

Enjoy clean, modern holograms

Compatibility
• Minecraft: 1.21 – 1.21.11 • Java: 21+ • Servers: Paper / Purpur / Spigot
